cards.title: Implementation of Likelihood-Based BQL Methods (M2/M3)
cards.claim: The M3 method is implemented in NONMEM VI using the F_FLAG functionality, where F_FLAG=0 indicates a prediction (above LOQ) and F_FLAG=1 indicates a likelihood (below LOQ). The M2 method uses YLO functionality. M3 consistently outperforms M2 in reducing bias across tested models.
conditions: Use of NONMEM VI or equivalent software supporting simultaneous continuous/categorical likelihood modeling.
Log-transformation of the dependent variable is applied to avoid negative predictions.
Residual error models must be specified to handle the log-scale or combined error structures appropriately.
required_inputs: Data file with F_FLAG or YLO columns.
Model code specifying the likelihood contribution for BQL observations.
limitations: Specific to NONMEM VI implementation details (F_FLAG/YLO).
Requires careful specification of residual error models (e.g., additive component on normal scale for log-transformed data).
Higher computational burden and convergence issues compared to FOCE.
cards.downstream_use: Implement M3 using F_FLAG for population PK/PD modeling. Ensure residual error models are compatible with the log-transformation and censoring mechanism.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
